description: K card worded by reason (review finding L3-2). The AI deploys both seats of the 2000-pt Ork mirror on the crucible_of_battle triangle (plans off, each Deffkilla Wartrike leading a 6-bike Warbikers unit, as in ai_deploy_p0_legal_formations) and is stopped the instant P1 is to deploy Warbikers Gamma + Deffkilla Wartrike Alpha. On that board the unit's two terrain spots are refused because their builds ran out of evaluations, and the unit goes to the column spot. Handed to a local hot-seat human, Suggest (K) must say so: each such spot reads 'not used: no legal set-up found within the build budget' and the override reason 'N higher-scoring spots were not fully tried: the build budget for this drop ran out' - never 'no legal set-up fits there' / 'no legal set-up for the whole unit fits at N higher-scoring spots', which the card used to print for any refused spot. K executes nothing.

steps.script: main._ai_suggestion_panel.breakdown_text.contains("not used: no legal set-up found within the build budget")
main._ai_suggestion_panel.breakdown_text.contains("not fully tried: the build budget for this drop ran out")
main._ai_suggestion_panel.breakdown_text.contains("no legal set-up for the whole unit fits")
